Clause 9.12.1 - heritage (heritage): The precinct contains three Heritage Conservation Areas being the Porter’s Brickworks Estate Heritage Conservation Area, Jarvie Ave nue Heritage Conservation Area and  the Rathlin Estate Heritage Conservation Area.

Clause 9.12.1 - heritage (heritage): This precinct also contain s a small part of the HCA 28 Dulwich Hill Commercial Precinct Heritage Conservation Area located on Marrickville Road.

Clause 9.12.2 - heritage (heritage): To protect and preserve the identified period buildings within the precinct and encourage their sympathetic alteration or restoration.

Clause 9.12.2 - heritage (heritage): To protect the identified Heritage Items  within the precinct.

Clause 9.12.2 - other (development_control): To maintain distinctly single storey streetscapes that exist within the precinct.

Clause 9.12.2 - other (development_control): To protect groups or runs of buildings which retain their original form including roof form s, original detailing and finishes.

Clause 9.12.2 - other (development_control): To protect  significant streetscape s and/or public domain elements within the precinct including landscaping, fencing, open space, sandstone kerbing and guttering, views and vistas and prevailing subdivision patterns.

Clause 9.12.2 - zoning (land_use_zoning): To preserve the predominantly low density residential character of the precinct.
